original.statement: The External Workloads feature is deprecated in 1.17 and will be removed in v1.18.

decision.reason: [ev-b5054e15ad6c] says that the External Workloads feature "has been deprecated and will be removed in v1.18". It still exists in 1.17, so the change type "deprecated" is correct. The evidence names only the feature, with no flag, Helm value, gate or CRD field. The free-form name "external-workloads", built from the evidence's own words, is the closest subject the text supports. Confidence is low because protocol-behavior is not a perfect fit for a whole product feature.
